Subject: VPC commercial ask — need breakdown and amortization options

Hi Neha / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. MedSys is very keen on a Private (VPC) deployment but our procurement team needs a clear breakdown for budget planning. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you provide a line-by-line commercial breakdown that separates the one-time implementation/onboarding charges from the recurring platform stewardship fee and per-node licenses? We need to know what can be capitalized vs. expensed.

2) For customers who prefer amortizing the platform stewardship fee monthly vs. upfront, do you offer alternate payment schedules or discounts for 24/36 month commitments? If so, please list typical discount bands and any conditions (e.g., minimum commit, support tier required).

We have attached our internal procurement form for completeness. Also include any optional SKUs (training days, priority on-call, SOC2 artifacts delivery).

Best,
Daniel
Director, Platform Engineering
MedSys Health

Subject: Re: VPC commercial ask — need breakdown and amortization options

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Putting together a short options matrix for MedSys; see the attached PDF (redwood-pricing-options-v1.pdf) for line items, and summary below.

Summary (high level):
- One-time implementation: base onboarding (2 weeks) + optional migration retainer. Typical: $45k base + $8k per week of extended migration. Capitalizable in most customers' accounting.
- Recurring: Platform stewardship fee (covers control plane, updates, security patching) + per-node license (GPU nodes). Stewardship fee can be paid upfront or amortized monthly.
- Discounts: Standard practice is 15% off stewardship with a 24-month prepay; 25% for 36-month prepay. We can increase discount by 5% if a commitment includes a minimum node count (>=10 nodes) or an annual committed spend.
- Support tiers (descriptions in PDF): Standard (business hours), Premium (24/7 support + 4hr P1 SLA), Enterprise (dedicated SRE by-seat and weekly cadence). Premium/Enterprise require a minimum platform fee threshold.

Open questions for you: expected sustained QPS/throughput and anticipated steady-state node count (first 12 months). Those drive per-node licensing and discount eligibility.

I looped in Marissa for finance/contracting notes — Marissa, can you confirm the standard DocuSign terms we should propose for a 24 vs 36-month amortization?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-options-v1.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medsys.com>

Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: VPC commercial ask — need breakdown and amortization options

Thanks Neha — the PDF is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Expected steady-state: 12 nodes (mixed vGPU), peak 18 nodes during onboarding.
- Target: prefer to capitalise as much as allowed. Is the onboarding retainer fully capitalizable?
- Migration credit: Does Redwood apply a one-time migration/implementation credit to the first invoice if we sign a 36-month prepay? If so, what is the typical size (percentage or dollar)?
- On-call SRE: For Enterprise, what is the typical monthly cost for a named SRE vs an on-call rotation? We want to estimate run-rate.
- Audit logs/data retention: we need confirmation that audit logs retention can be set to 7 years (or a plan for export) for compliance.

Procurement has also asked whether platform stewardship fees are recognized as OPEX or can be structured in a way that our finance team can treat as CAPEX — any guidance you can provide for our accounting team would help.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Daniel

Hi all — looping in from the sales side with a recommended commercial structure that maps to MedSys numbers. Key points below; happy to iterate.

Recommended commercial (working draft):
- Platform stewardship fee: $120k/year (covers control plane, updates, security, minimal telemetry retention).
- Per-node license: $6k/node/year for GPU heavy nodes; applies to each active node.
- Implementation/onboarding: $45k one-time; includes 2-week onsite/remote start and runbook delivery.

Discount / amortization options: 
- 24-month prepay: 20% off platform fee if prepaid annually (equivalent to ~10% effective annual discount if amortized monthly).
- 36-month prepay: 30% off platform fee + one-time migration credit equal to 8% of first-year platform fee (applied on invoice 1).
- Minimum node count for these bands: none, but discounts escalate for >=10 nodes.

Support SKUs (optional):
- Named SRE (part-time): $12k/month (up to 40 hours/month)
- Priority on-call rotation (shared): $6k/month
- Training days: $2.5k/day

Accounting note: onboarding (professional services) is usually capitalizable; stewardship fee is typically OPEX. For customers that require CAPEX treatment of stewardship, we are happy to sign multi-year prepay with an explicit amortization schedule in the MSA; Marissa — we should include language in the SOW to help MedSys finance.

Next steps: Neha / Marissa to produce a concise SOW and proposed DocuSign package reflecting 36-month prepay + migration credit. Daniel — if you can confirm you want the 36-month path, we'll prepare a redlined SOW.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Neha / Rishi — thanks, that structure is workable. A few quick confirmations before we route to legal/procurement: 

1) Confirm migration credit: one-time credit equal to 8% of first-year platform fee applied against invoice 1 for a 36-month prepay.
2) Confirm that onboarding (the $45k) will be listed as "implementation professional services" in the SOW and flagged as capitalizable.
3) Confirm audit logs: Redwood will retain/export audit logs for up to 7 years; include export tooling / S3 export in the SOW.

If you confirm these in writing, procurement will circulate the redlined MSA and then we can push DocuSign. We prefer the 36-month path and will sign contingent on the SOW reflecting the items above.

Thanks — we'll aim to have legal review within 72 hours once you send the updated SOW.

Regards,
